names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Ermie»; the life page declines him as «Ermia» throughout.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ερμείας», with the rank word left off. The hymns on the same page inflect it «Ἑρμεία».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 31 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Ermie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ερμείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is the same man: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ερμείας, ζούσε στα Κόμανα της Καππαδοκίας», a soldier of long service brought before the duke Sebastian and beheaded in old age, which is the story doxologia's life tells. **This row is his and not the other Ermie's.** doxologia prints two men of the name on 31 mai and the corpus holds both — «Sfântul Apostol Ermie», the folder `hermas-31-may`, and this soldier of Comana — while saint.gr's day page prints only one Ερμείας, and its life is the soldier's. So nothing is owed to `hermas-31-may` from this day, and that is a reading of the two pages and not a statement about the apostle. `dates` are added where the folder had none. **Two hymns are stored, the proper apolytikion and the kontakion, both of which name him.** The page also prints a second apolytikion, «Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε», which is the general common of a martyr and names nobody; it is left in the source, and the megalynarion with it.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Ermie, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Ermie; the text is the common of a martyr with his name set in it.

english.text: Thy martyr Hermias, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength he overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Χριστῷ στρατευσάμενος, τῷ Βασιλεῖ τοῦ παντός, γενναίως διέκοψας, τὰς παρατάξεις ἐχθρῶν. Ἑρμεία πανένδοξε· σὺ γὰρ ἐγκαρτερήσας, πολυτρόποις αἰκίαις, ἤθλησας ἐν τῷ γήρᾳ, ὡς τοῦ Λόγου ὁπλίτης· ὧ πρέσβευε Ἀθλοφόρε, σώζεσθαι ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Άγιος Ερμείας»; the second is the general common of a martyr and is left there

english.text: Having taken service with Christ, the King of all, thou didst bravely cut through the ranks of the enemy, O all-glorious Hermias; for having endured torments of every kind, thou didst contend in thine old age as a soldier of the Word. Intercede, O prize-bearer, that all may be saved.

hymns.text: Τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὸ ὄνομα, ὁμολογήσας εὐτόνως, καὶ σφοδρῶν κολάσεων, ὑπενεγκὼν τὰς ὀδύνας, ᾔσχυνας, τῶν παρανόμων τὰς ἐπινοίας· ἔδειξας, τῆς εὐσεβείας πᾶσι τὸ κράτος· διὰ τοῦτό σε Ἑρμεία, ὁ Ἀθλοθέτης Λόγος ἐδόξασε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιος Ερμείας»

english.text: Having confessed the name of Christ with vigour, and borne the pains of violent punishments, thou didst put to shame the devices of the lawless and show to all the strength of godliness; and for this the Word, the bestower of the prize, has glorified thee, O Hermias.

death.note: saint.gr: «Τελικά τον αποκεφάλισαν χαρίζοντας του το στέφανο της δόξας το 160 μ.Χ.» The page's heading is «Άγιος Ερμείας (; - 160)» and gives no year of birth, only that he was already of venerable old age when he was taken. **The same page names two emperors for the one persecution** — it puts him «την εποχή του αυτοκράτορα των Ρωμαίων Αντωνίνου Πίου» and the persecution «την περίοδο της βασιλείας του Μάρκου Αυρήλιου (138 - 161 μ.Χ.)», where those dates are Antoninus Pius's reign and not Marcus Aurelius's — so no reign is recorded as an interval, and only the year the page gives for the beheading is entered.
